completeness.why: Forecast, action sync, posting and preview now pass their raw amount to the existing getScheduledAmount, which decides missing/number/range. The budget template calls it with an explicit 'round-sum-then-half' mode (the preserved inconsistency made explicit) but keeps its own op === 'isbetween' ? ... : value dispatch, which sites.json lists as nothing to preserve, so part of the decision stays at that site.

interface.why: Reuses the existing helper and adds one named rounding-mode parameter for the only real variation, keeping the default for every other caller; the template's leftover op dispatch keeps the interface from fully covering that site.

disguised_duplication.where: The four midpoint ternaries are removed outright; the template's remaining op ternary is left as it was, not reshaped.
